work as CC0. Attribution is not required, but this notice is retained for
traceability.

`RPGCharacterSprites32x32-transparent.png` is a project-local derivative. It
only replaces the source sheet's exact magenta color key (`#ff00ff`) with full
transparency; sprite pixels and layout are unchanged.
